'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Lee Edwards DS Drop''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Lee Edwards]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2). The sheet's deck title is ''My Tank is Fight''.

One card line on the sheet matches no card title. It is left unlinked and marked ''(unknown card)'' in the list below, and it is listed under Missing data at [[Talk:2007 Worlds Day 2 Lee Edwards DS Drop]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Lee Edwards]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
